errors.evidence: A logarithmic scale does not include 0. The axis starts at an origin labeled 0, but the log scale itself begins at a value greater than 0 (in this case, the first data points are around x=5).

errors.text_span: with tick marks at intervals of 10¹, 10², and 10³
errors.evidence: On a logarithmic scale, these are the values of the tick marks, not the intervals between them. The intervals are multiplicative (by a factor of 10), not additive.
